purpose: Document first-party local cadastral/registry evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Public official sources confirm local cadastral work and records. Shengze government reporting describes an internal land/resource management system that incorporates parcel maps for administrative workflows, not an open public parcel API. Public real-estate-registration service locations are listed, but no anonymous vector geometry was identified.
registryAssessment: Official Wujiang District government page identifies the Shengze Natural Resources Office and states that it manages land rights, assists with land and cadastral surveys/registration, and provides archive query services. This is specific local-custodian evidence.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Wujiang District government names the Shengze Natural Resources Office, gives its location, and states it manages local land rights, supports land/cadastral and change surveys, registration/certificates, and archive queries.
Official district convenience-services page lists the Shengze town real-estate registration service counter and address.
Suzhou City Management Bureau report describes Shengze internal operational systems using parcel maps (宗地图) as part of land/resource management workflows; this is not a public geometry service.
Official Wujiang land-space planning portal publishes Shengze town planning notices; planning polygons are not cadastral parcel geometry.
